name: Blacktop Outlaws: Motorbike Brawl Racing
summary:
**The fight is real because the arms are yours.**

- Hold the handlebars to ride; let go with one hand to strike. Every punch is your punch, every swing your swing.
- Read the wind-up, then lean away or duck under it. Block with a hand, parry with a weapon.
- Knock a rival's weapon loose and snatch it out of the air: tire irons, bats, pipes, batons, chains, nunchaku, cattle prods and a two-metre bullwhip.
